title: The Footprints That Ended
premise_public: A trail of fresh footprints crossed a snowy field to a cabin. No footprints led away, but when rescuers opened the cabin, nobody was inside.
solution_summary: The visitor walked to the cabin carrying skis, put them on, and departed across the snow. Their departure left long ski tracks rather than footprints.

facts.text: Different marks were left in the snow during departure.
Nobody remained hidden in the cabin.

acceptable_solutions: The visitor left on skis, making tracks instead of footprints.
They walked there but skied away, so no footsteps led back.
The person brought skis and left across the snow using them.
hints: No return footprints does not mean nobody departed.
Different ways of traveling leave different marks in snow.
